name: kitti360_paper_v1

frame_rules.keep_every_m: 2.5 for every drive except 0000, which keeps all frames
frame_rules.usable: image, scan, pose, aligned (gap <= 20 ms), >= 50 m of future path; val and test frames must also lie inside a semantic window (the evaluation ground truth exists only there), train frames need not
frame_rules.revisit_m: 50: val/test frames within 50 m (GPS) of any train frame are dropped (0006 passes 0004/0005 on 5-13 % of its route)
frame_rules.sample_m: 5: training, teacher and evaluation frames are kept usable frames every 5 m
frame_rules.frame_level_split: written as a separate file once every drive's frame index exists

rationale.test: 0009 + 0010: the richest hard cases (85 moving pedestrians, 54 cyclists, 1218 parked cars), in their own area with no overlap with any train drive
rationale.val: 0006: pedestrians and parked cars; its stretches near 0004/0005 are removed by the 50 m rule
rationale.train: 0000 + 0002 + 0004 + 0005: 38.4 km of residential and suburban driving for the self-supervised road training
rationale.unused: 0003 and 0007: fast roads with almost no near-obstacle cases; 0007 could serve later as an extra road-type test

evidence: scripts/drive_stats.py (poses, OXTS and 3D boxes of all nine training drives); numbers in data/kitti360_meta/drive_stats.json
